episodes.title: The Electric Boy
episodes.summary: Early 20th-century Kyoto. Kihachi witnesses the wonders of electricity with Seiroku. Four years later, alone and cynical, he meets a girl deep in prayer.

episodes.title: The Mysteries of the Catalog
episodes.summary: In a haze of incense, Yosuke storms into Kihachi's workshop and demands the Catalog — and his fiancée. But why does Inako have it in the first place?

episodes.title: Their Dream
episodes.summary: Full of denial, Yosuke clashes with Kihachi. Later, Inako's sharp senses reveal a secret and her belief inspires Kihachi to recreate an invention.

episodes.title: The Steadfast Girl
episodes.summary: Inako meets a grieving shop owner whose loss echoes her own. Fully believing in Kihachi's skills, she asks him to build an electric machine to help.

episodes.title: Proof of Love
episodes.summary: Kihachi's latest experiment catches the eye of a strange university graduate, who's convinced that it can help him prove his passion to his crush.

episodes.title: The sound of innovation
episodes.summary: Yosuke challenges Kihachi and the gang to a music battle. With only Inako having musical experience, can they master electric instruments in a week?

episodes.title: Elopement
episodes.summary: On the day of Inako's engagement ceremony, Kihachi urges her to chase her dreams and helps her escape. Guided by Stuart's letter, they head for Shiga.

episodes.title: His Brother's Footsteps
episodes.summary: Before Kihachi can figure out how to fix the electric key, Kengo breaks down and confesses the secret he's been carrying for the past three years.

episodes.title: The time to say goodbye
episodes.summary: Kihachi makes a shocking decision to protect Inako, but she takes matters into her own hands. Yosuke reminisces about his first meeting with Seiroku.

episodes.title: Engagement Trouble
episodes.summary: Yosuke makes a critical discovery. After Inako and Kihachi clear up their misunderstanding, they help Kengo reconcile with Noriko using a shocking plan.
